articles.title: Bitcoin bears pay to bet on further declines as futures positions near yearly lows
articles.description: Overall demand for leveraged exposure remains weak, marked by sliding futures open interest. The capital that's still in the market appears skewed toward bearish positions.

articles.title: RedotPay completes financial audit as it presses ahead with U.S. IPO plans
articles.description: The stablecoin payments company said the audit is part of its preparations to go public, disputing an August report that the listing had been put on hold.

articles.title: California's Newsom signs memecoin ban and calls it 'The Opposite of Trump'
articles.description: The California Governor signed AB 2409 as part of an anti-corruption package, framing it as a response to President Trump's $TRUMP fiasco.

articles.title: Solana ETFs draw record $188 million in a week as Bitwise takes two-thirds of inflows
articles.description: All seven funds attracted money, while Friday’s $87 million intake set a daily record.

articles.title: Bitcoin, Nasdaq futures decline as Trump won’t rule out more Iran strikes
articles.description: Trump on Sunday didn’t rule out additional strikes on Iran before the midterm elections, even as he said the war could end soon.

articles.title: Vitalik Buterin maps Ethereum’s shift beyond a blockchain in sweeping 2030 vision
articles.description: Buterin wants Ethereum to do far more work without forcing every computer on the network to repeat the same calculations.

articles.title: How months of work on the Clarity Act all fell apart
articles.description: Interviews with industry participants and legislative aides paint a picture of a blown bill-writing process, with sources pointing to nearly every facet of the bill's development and the debate around it as contributing factors to this month's failed vote.

articles.title: Kraken’s parent Payward is betting billions on becoming financial infrastructure, not just a crypto exchange
articles.description: Kraken parent Payward is unifying trading, payments, asset management and institutional services on common rails, co-CEO Arjun Sethi said.

articles.title: Binance deal gives Circle a boost in stablecoin race with Tether, analysts say
articles.description: The five-year deal could strengthen USDC’s reach in emerging markets, though Tether’s liquidity advantage remains hard to dislodge, analysts told CoinDesk.

articles.title: Bitget hacker moves $83 million in stolen XRP beyond reach of freeze controls
articles.description: Two wallets have been almost emptied and a third is being drained, with about $75 million remaining across the five original holding accounts.

articles.title: Bitcoin could soon get Zcash-style 'shielded' privacy without changing its rules
articles.description: Researchers have mapped out private bitcoin-denominated transfers that run alongside Bitcoin, but the system still lacks a finished way to lock up real BTC and release it again.

articles.title: Solana’s 150-millisecond settlement upgrade reaches second public test network
articles.description: Alpenglow is running on both public test networks, giving application teams a place to check their software before the live blockchain switches.

articles.title: XRP Ledger’s Batch upgrade slips to Oct. 9 after validator support resets
articles.description: The feature would let users bundle up to eight transactions, including asset-and-payment transfers, but a brief drop below the network’s 80% support threshold restarted its two-week activation clock.

articles.title: U.S. SEC's steadiest crypto advocate, Hester Peirce, to depart next week
articles.description: The long-anticipated exit of the commissioner sometimes known as Crypto Mom is Oct. 2, announced as the agency was sending out its latest crypto work.

articles.title: Another appeals court rules against prediction market provider Kalshi, says sports contracts are subject to state regulations
articles.description: A Sixth Circuit Court of Appeals panel ruled that prediction markets' sports-related events contracts are not swaps, and therefore aren't subject to federal regulatory oversight.

articles.title: Blockchain Association sees leadership shift shortly after crypto Clarity Act fizzles
articles.description: The trade group will be run again by its original CEO, Kristin Smith, when Summer Mersinger leaves at the end of a long congressional tussle.

articles.title: Circle and Tether step in to freeze hacker wallet after massive Bitget crypto heist
articles.description: The stablecoin issuer blacklisted a wallet holding about $318,000 in USDT and USDC. Most of the stolen funds sit in ether, which can't be frozen.

articles.title: Tokenization is moving faster than Washington
articles.description: Regulatory clarity is not simply a legal or political issue, argues former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo. It is an economic one.

articles.title: Tether confirms minimal EQIBank exposure following $89M US asset seizure
articles.description: While Tether's stated ceiling places its maximum exposure under $64 million, the incident underscores lingering counterparty risks in fiat gateway networks.

articles.title: Strategy proposes daily dividends to bring STRC back toward $100
articles.description: STRC has remained below $100 since May, despite a 12% dividend rate and roughly $1 billion in preferred share buybacks.

articles.title: Bond volatility surges while bitcoin and Wall Street stay calm
articles.description: Bond volatility is at its highest since March, while the bitcoin VIX, BVIV and Wall Street's VIX remain near its yearly low.

articles.title: Bitcoin holders are cashing out, just not the way they did at prior market tops
articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Sept. 25, 2026

articles.title: Altcoins rally across the board as bitcoin consolidates near $84,000
articles.description: Quant jumped 39% over 24 hours and 93 of 100 CoinDesk 100 constituents rose, with the altcoin season index at its highest in more than three months.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETF flows turn positive for 2026 after erasing $5.8 billion deficit
articles.description: At one point in July, ETFs were down $5.8 billion in net outflows for the year. Now, that’s turned into $800 million in net inflows.

articles.title: KelpDAO sues LayerZero for the largest exploit 2026 has seen so far
articles.description: The cross-chain lending protocol accused LayerZero and its co-founder Brian Pellegrino of failing to disclose weaknesses in their protocol, which led to the $292 million hack.
